description: Compact typesafe.pro brand kit for sandboxed demos. Tokens mirror apps/web/src/app/globals.css; the CSS for every class lives in demo-brand.ts. The generator (tools/seo) reads the class list and guidelines from this file.
font: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

classes.ts-stack: Vertical layout with 16px gaps; wrap the whole demo in one.
classes.ts-row: Horizontal wrapping row with 12px gaps, items centred (input + button, chips).
classes.ts-grid: Responsive grid of equal tiles (min 140px) for categories or options.
classes.ts-card: Raised surface with border and 14px radius for a group of content.
classes.ts-panel: Tinted result area (site result-panel look) for the visual output.
classes.ts-eyebrow: Small uppercase monospace accent label above a heading.
classes.ts-title: Section heading inside the demo (20px, semibold).
classes.ts-text: Body copy in the secondary text colour.
classes.ts-label: Form label; put the input inside it or use for= with an id.
classes.ts-textarea: Multi-line text field, full width, 3 rows tall.
classes.ts-btn: Primary pill button (dark on light, light on dark) for the main action.
classes.ts-btn-secondary: Outlined pill button for secondary actions (add with ts-btn).
classes.ts-chip: Small pill toggle for sample inputs or options; add is-active when selected.
classes.ts-badge: Tiny rounded tag for a label or status value.
classes.ts-status: One-line status message; add is-error or is-loading; give it aria-live=polite.
classes.ts-value: Large accent number or label for the headline result.
classes.ts-meter: Rounded progress track; contains one ts-meter-fill.
classes.ts-meter-fill: Fill of a meter; set style.width to a percentage, animates smoothly.
classes.ts-legend: Row of legend items for categorical colours.
classes.ts-swatch: Small colour dot for a legend item; set background to a --ts-cN token.
classes.ts-spinner: Small spinning loader shown while a request runs.

guidelines: Build all standard controls from the ts-* classes; write custom CSS only for the scenario-specific visual (shapes, gradients, particles, animations) and scope it under #demo.

Use colours only through var(--ts-*) tokens; use --ts-c1 … --ts-c6 for categories or options so the demo stays on brand and readable in light and dark themes. Never set the page background, text colour or font family.
Do not repeat the demo title or concept: the page already shows them above the frame. Start with the input.
Keep it one column and fluid (it must work from 320px to 760px wide); no fixed widths above 320px.
The frame grows to the content height automatically: never use vh/vw units, and never set height or min-height on html, body or #demo.
Motion uses CSS transitions or keyframes of 200–800ms; the kit already respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Label every input, give the status element aria-live=polite, and keep text at 12px or larger.
